description: Legitimate-repeat fixtures and a heterogeneous-object fixture for repetition_collapse. Each fixture carries an explicit expected_label: 'loop' means the buffer is a degenerate repetition collapse the detector MUST flag; 'allow' means the buffer is a legitimate repeating structure the detector MUST NOT flag. The detector output is compared byte-for-byte across runs. Every 'allow' fixture's repeating unit is intentionally longer than RC_DEFAULT_MIN_SPAN_BYTES=60 so the corpus exercises region/JSON suppression, not just the min_span pre-filter. The heterogeneous-object fixture is locked against the in-module JSON grammar (see src/detect/repetition_collapse.c).
